playbook:
1. Prioritize geography, science, math, and Minecraft quizzes; skip generic general‑knowledge or plain flag‑guessing unless it has a twist.  
2. Keep questions easy‑to‑medium, requiring a quick, non‑obvious answer.  
3. Open each short with a 2‑second hook teasing a surprising fact or twist.  
4. Title videos as a concise question (6‑8 words) and attach one relevant hashtag.  
5. Use “Guess”, “What”, or “Reverse” prompts to invite fast answers and add playful flair.  
6. Avoid broad or trivial questions (e.g., “How many continents are there?”) and overly obvious sports queries.  
7. Keep the hashtag list short (1‑3 tags) and specific to the content.  
8. Craft unique phrasing; never copy another channel’s exact title or question wording.
